name: CoAsia Electronics Corp.
summary: CoAsia Electronics Corp. provides components for mobile multimedia in Taiwan, rest of Asia, and Europe. The company offers CMOS, 3D, and automotive image sensors; processors, PMICs, and NFC components; memory products, such as DRAM, SSD, eStorage, and MCP; and foundry solutions. It also provides mobile and IT AMOLEDs; and OIS+AF controller and driver ICs for camera modules, and MicroLED driver ICs, as well as micro controller units for remote controllers, and small home and LCD applications. In addition, the company manufactures and sells semiconductor peripheral products; and engages in the software and hardware technology development, and international trade and entrepot trade activities, …
